name: Senior candidate negotiates only on gross, never engages tax-optimised structure
notes: v5.5.0 realism: tax_structure_naive — leaves 1-2 LPA on the table at ₹40L+ band.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Senior platform engineer, 10 years across Walmart Labs and Target India, on the supply-chain platform.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why are you considering a switch?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Want to move into agentic-supply-chain — current scope is mature for me.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about a project you owned end to end.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Rebuilt the inventory-allocation engine to cut SLA breaches from 12% to 3%; owned spec to launch over seven months across 14 warehouses.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Walk me through a hard cross-functional disagreement.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Ops wanted same-day promise extended; engineering capacity wouldn't hold. Ran a six-week shadow rollout, brought data, aligned in three weeks.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 60 days notice, buyout possible at one month gross with manager sign-off and a handover plan.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: ₹58 LPA fixed, ₹10 LPA variable paid out at 85% historically, ₹5 LPA joining bonus, RSU vest of ₹40 LPA over 4 years.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Looking at a 28% jump on fixed. So roughly ₹74 LPA fixed plus the variable and joining bonus.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: BGV — payslips, Form 16, UAN, relieving letters — all in order?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Yes. Form 16 for last three years, UAN active, last 6 payslips, relieving letter from Walmart Labs ready to share.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Your team's last-mile optimisation work and the scale of the SCOT org are the exact problems I want to solve next.
